pages.text: Altered from $(5)Multishot$(), $(4)Star Release$() makes the user shoot in eight equally divided directions around them. Maximum level is $(4)I$() and it conflicts with $(5)Piercing$(), $(5)Multishot$() and $(4)Battering$().

pages.title: Notes
pages.text: It is quite difficult to aim with, yet it can also be rather hard to miss.
